spec.description: T-82 variant (not a scored figure): the organisers' real house, calibrated to its measured gas use. Generated by scripts/calibrate_real_house.py (efficiency 0.86).

sources.measured_gas: Hackathon organisers, Housedata (anonymised), meter MESSPUNKT_004, monthly kWh 2025; local copy data/external/housedata (not committed), see data/raw/housedata/SOURCE.md
sources.boiler_efficiency: Regulation (EU) No 813/2013, Annex II 1(a): seasonal space heating energy efficiency of fuel boiler space heaters <= 70 kW shall not fall below 86 % from 26 September 2015 (https://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2013/813/annex/II/adopted, accessed 2026-11-22). Minimum for new boilers; the house's boiler type and age are unknown, so the real efficiency may be lower.
sources.method: least squares on months with a reading: heat = design_heating_kw x S_m + hot_water_kwh_per_day x days_m, S_m from the case formula on Basel 2025 weather (config/reference-house.json constants)
sources.hot_water_kwh_per_day: fitted (see method); includes all summer gas use (hot water and boiler/circulation losses cannot be separated from monthly data)
sources.position_weather_price: assumed Basel: the address is anonymised; case weather, cell cap-bs and IWB H4 price as the reference house
sources.tank: 35 kWh lossless, case value (the house's storage is unknown)
